newsitem.title: UK: UK wheat futures prices once again hit by currency.
newsitem.headline: UK wheat futures prices once again hit by currency.

text.p: Fresh gains by sterling versus a number of European currencies once again pushed prices lower on the UK wheat futures markets on Friday.
"Renewed strength on sterling has again been the major feature of the day," said one broker.
LIFFE wheat futures closed 0.55 to 1.60 stg down after trading 427 lots.
The cash wheat market was very subdued, reflecting the trend set by the futures market. --Stephen Grainger, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
